Fit SuSiE-OUT by averaging sparse-count and nuisance states

Source: R/prior_grid_fit.R
susieout_fit_grid.Rd

Every sparse-count state is combined with every nuisance state. Posterior state weights use the complete variational evidence stored by the conditional fit, including likelihood normalization and variational uncertainty.

Usage

susieout_fit_grid(
  z,
  n,
  R_analysis,
  wgs_ld = NULL,
  examined_ids = NULL,
  effect_prior = "robust_mixture",
  L = 10L,
  prior_grid = susieout_prior_grid(),
  nuisance_prior = NULL,
  trained_prior = NULL,
  infinitesimal_variance = 0,
  ld_mismatch_variance = 0,
  starts = c("zero", "inside", "mixed"),
  keep_fits = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

z, n, R_analysis, wgs_ld, examined_ids, effect_prior, L

Arguments passed to susieout_fit().

prior_grid

A grid returned by susieout_prior_grid().

nuisance_prior

Optional frozen nuisance prior returned by susieout_train_nuisance_grid().

trained_prior

Optional frozen effect/nuisance prior. Its count prior is replaced by each sparse-grid state.

infinitesimal_variance, ld_mismatch_variance

Singleton nuisance values used when nuisance_prior is NULL.

starts

Deterministic initialization strategies. The highest-evidence converged fit is retained for each grid state.

keep_fits

Retain conditional fits in diagnostics.

...

Additional arguments passed to susieout_fit().

Value

A model-averaged susieout_fit.
